access_evidence: GET /api/comext/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/DS-045409 returned HTTP 200 with JSON-stat values for 7 of 8 requested reporters, 5 HS4 codes x 2 flows x 2015-2024, in 8 requests.
blockers: NO_BULK_TSV: format=TSV and format=CSV are rejected (HTTP 400 'Invalid value for wsOutputFormat parameter'); only JSON-stat was usable.
NO_CATALOGUE_ENDPOINT: /api/comext/dissemination/catalogue/datasets/ returns 404, so the current DS code list had to be known in advance.
EU_AGGREGATE_ABSENT: reporter=EU27_2020 and reporter=EU returned no values for these products; the aggregate must be computed by the caller.
NO_PER_OBSERVATION_RELEASE_DATE: only a dataset-level 'updated' timestamp is exposed.
historical_depth: annual from 1988 (dataset label: 'EU trade since 1988 by HS2-4-6 and CN8')
licence_note: 'Reuse of statistical data, metadata, publications, and other dissemination tools published on this website for commercial or non-commercial purposes is authorised provided the source is acknowledged.' (Eurostat copyright notice; Commission Decision of 12 December 2011 on the reuse of Commission documents.)
machine_interface: REST JSON-stat 2.0 (dissemination API); browser UI at /comext/newxtweb/
name: Eurostat Comext — DS-045409 EU trade by HS2-4-6 and CN8
notes: Value in EUR; mass in 100 kg. No deflation, no FX conversion.
rate_policy: No key, no documented quota; collection throttled to ~1.5 req/s by the client.
robots_summary: not relied upon; reuse is explicitly authorised by the copyright notice
unlock_route: Comext bulk download exists only through the interactive https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/comext/newxtweb/ application (a JS UI with no documented machine bulk URL found), so the dissemination API is the legitimate machine route.
what_is_new: 1400 Comext observations (value in EUR and net mass) for 7 EU reporters x 9018/9019/9020/9021/9022 x imports/exports x 2015-2024 — fills the Comtrade France gap and gives an independent second compilation of the same customs declarations.
